title_sq: Ambjent komercial per shitje tek qendra tregtare ETC
description_sq:
Shitet ambient komercial ne Qendren Tregtare ETC.
Ambienti ka nje siperfaqe te brendshme 35,5m2 i organizuar ne open space.
Ky ambjent ka gjithashtu nje lokacion perfekt ne nje nga qendrat me te mira tregtare ne Tirane dhe ofrohet bosh.
Administrimi dhe reklamimi qe ofrohen nga vete qendra tregtare eshte nje avantazh per cdo biznes te mundshem pasi perfshin mirembajtje dhe reklamim ne disa hapesira te Qendres.
Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion dhe nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: Commercial space for sale at the ETC shopping center
description_en: Commercial space for sale in the ETC Shopping Center. The environment has an internal surface of 35.5 m2 organized in open space. This space also has a perfect location in one of the best shopping centers in Tirana and is offered vacant. The administration and advertising offered by the shopping center itself is an advantage for any possible business as it includes maintenance and advertising in some areas of the Center. It has full mortgage documentation. For more information and a visit to the property, contact us!
